text:
ana: heads-up: teams are getting banner fatigue about v1 sunset. can we run a short pilot that suppresses deprecation banners for a handful of tenants while still collecting signals? want to avoid churn from noisy warnings while we fix a few edgecases

sam: what exactly would the suppression do? just hide UI banners or stop server-side warnings too? need clarity for telemetry and quotas

ana: start with UI only. we still collect usage/telemetry/quota. engineering needs the raw numbers to measure migration progress

kai: agree keep telemetry. suggestion: emit a dedicated metric `api.deprecations.silenced` with tenant and cohort tags so we can separate natural declines from suppression effects

margo: on the console side we should add an "experiment" panel on the deprecation page: cohort selection, sample rate slider (0-100%), and a preview of the banner. PMs should be able to preview copy before enabling

ana: pilot sketch: 10 tenants, 14 days, split exposures 0/25/100 to create an internal control. need an admin toggle (opt-in) plus audit log entries for transparency

sam: billing question: if we're hiding banners and a tenant stays on v1 and costs spike, CS needs a heads-up. surface a billing preview card showing projected delta if they remain on v1 vs move to v2

margo: yes. simple heuristic: use last 7d tokens * (v1_rate - v2_rate) to estimate delta. show prominently in modal when enabling suppression

kai: implementation idea: add a passthrough header `X-Redwood-Deprec-Silence: true` that proxy logs. ingestion marks events `deprec_silence` so dashboards can filter. example headers:
```
X-Client-Version: v1
X-Redwood-Deprec-Silence: true
```
Then emit metric and keep normal quota accounting

sam: risk: tenants might treat this like a permanent opt-out. impose hard pilot limits: max 30 days, with auto-expiry and explicit renewal via console and audit trail

ana: agreed. also add an admin checkbox: "I understand this is temporary" on the modal to reduce accidental long-term usage

margo: UX copy draft: "Deprecation warnings for this tenant are temporarily hidden as part of a migration pilot. Usage is still tracked and you may receive notices if we detect risky behavior." include link to migration guide

dave: small proxy change can preserve and log the header without touching routing hot path. pseudo: 
```
if req.headers.get('x-redwood-deprec-silence') == 'true':
  access_log.emit('deprec_silence', tenant=req.tenant_id)
```
I'll open a PR and add unit tests

deploy-bot: deploy started for proxy PR 3337 by dave  canary 3 hosts

sam: alerts we should add: (1) `silenced_tenant_usage_spike` when usage >2x baseline, (2) `cohort_migration_lag` if >80% still hitting v1 after 30d

margo: dashboard widget to surface alerts + link to audit log. also CS webhook when tenant opts in so support isn't blind

ana: console rollout: instead of a full page toggle, add a small inline badge next to the version that opens a modal to enable suppression. modal shows metrics, billing preview, and expiry date

kai: add server-side config per-tenant for `banner_sample_rate` and `silence_expiry` stored in the config service so ops can adjust without deploys

dave: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/proxy/pulls/3337  tests included. requesting eng-runtime review

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for proxy PR 3337  canary healthy on 3/3 hosts

margo: timeline: UX mock by Tue, telemetry hook by Thu, proxy patch in canary Fri, pilot start next Mon. filing follow-ups for metrics ticket, dashboard mock, and billing API endpoint

sam: I'll own alerts + billing preview API. will add alert runbooks

kai: I'll wire ingestion tagging and sample-rate config

ana: uploaded pilot doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/pilots/hide-deprecations -> please review and add CS/PM reviewers

margo: will sync with CS after review. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
